WITH ors_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        e.equipmentcode,
        CASE 
            WHEN om.operationalstatus = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1 - om.operationhours / om.maintenancecyclehours)
            WHEN om.operationalstatus = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1 - om.operationhours / om.maintenancecyclehours)
            ELSE 0
        END AS ors_score
    FROM equipment e
    JOIN operationmaintenance om ON e.equipmentcode = om.opmainteqref
    WHERE e.equipmenttype = 'Safety'
),
tie_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        e.equipmentcode,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.insulationstatus = 'Good' THEN 0.9 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10
            WHEN t.insulationstatus = 'Fair' THEN 0.6 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10
            WHEN t.insulationstatus = 'Poor' THEN 0.3 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10
            ELSE 0
        END AS tie_score
    FROM equipment e
    JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid t ON e.equipmentcode = t.thermaleqref
    WHERE e.equipmenttype = 'Safety'
),
lssr_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        o.equipmentcode,
        ROUND(CAST((0.7 * o.ors_score + 0.3 * t.tie_score) AS numeric), 2) AS reliability_score
    FROM ors_calc o
    JOIN tie_calc t ON o.equipmentcode = t.equipmentcode
)
SELECT 
    e.equipmentcode,
    e.equipmenttype,
    ls.lifesupportstatus,
    lc.reliability_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN lc.reliability_score >= 0.8 THEN 'High Reliability'
        WHEN lc.reliability_score >= 0.6 AND lc.reliability_score < 0.8 THEN 'Moderate Reliability'
        ELSE 'Low Reliability'

        'safety_system_status', ls.safetysystemstatus
    ) AS support_systems_status

JOIN lightingandsafety ls ON e.equipmentcode = ls.lighteqref
JOIN lssr_calc lc ON e.equipmentcode = lc.equipmentcode
WHERE e.equipmenttype = 'Safety'
ORDER BY e.equipmentcode;

WITH raw_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        e.equipmentcode,
        e.equipmenttype,
        ls.lifesupportstatus,
        ls.oxygensupplystatus,
        ls.medicalequipmentstatus,
        ls.safetysystemstatus,
        CASE 
            WHEN om.operationalstatus = 'Active' THEN 10 * (1 - om.operationhours / om.maintenancecyclehours)
            WHEN om.operationalstatus = 'Standby' THEN 5 * (1 - om.operationhours / om.maintenancecyclehours)
            ELSE 0
        END AS ors_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.insulationstatus = 'Good' THEN 0.9 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10
            WHEN t.insulationstatus = 'Fair' THEN 0.6 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10
            WHEN t.insulationstatus = 'Poor' THEN 0.3 - t.heatlossratekwh / 10
            ELSE 0
        END AS tie_score
    FROM equipment e
    JOIN lightingandsafety ls ON e.equipmentcode = ls.lighteqref
    JOIN operationmaintenance om ON e.equipmentcode = om.opmainteqref
    JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid t ON e.equipmentcode = t.thermaleqref
    WHERE e.equipmenttype = 'Safety'
),
lssr_calc AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROUND(CAST((0.7 * ors_score + 0.3 * tie_score) AS numeric), 2) AS reliability_score
    FROM raw_scores
)
SELECT 
    equipmentcode,
    equipmenttype,
    lifesupportstatus,
    reliability_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN reliability_score >= 0.8 THEN 'High Reliability'
        WHEN reliability_score >= 0.6 THEN 'Moderate Reliability'
        ELSE 'Low Reliability'
    END AS reliability_classification,
    json_build_object(
        'oxygen_status', oxygensupplystatus,
        'medical_status', medicalequipmentstatus,
        'safety_system_status', safetysystemstatus
    ) AS support_systems_status
FROM lssr_calc
ORDER BY reliability_score DESC;
